info.name: Vision Support Desk API
info.description:
REST API for Vision Support Desk (tickets, conversations, contacts, accounts, agents, departments, teams, Gmail ingestion).

Base path: `/api/v1`. Server default: `http://localhost:5000`.

### Response contract
- List endpoints: `{ "data": [...], "paging": { "limit", "page", "total", "hasMore", "nextCursor" } }`
- Single-resource endpoints: `{ "data": {...} }`
- Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details", "traceId" } }`

### Auth
No authentication is wired into any route yet (Login & Security module / `/api/v1/auth/*` is not implemented). Every write currently attributes to a system actor server-side. `auth.middleware.js` / `authorize.middleware.js` are ready for when JWT auth lands, expecting a `Bearer` token.

### Suggested flow to try this collection
1. Run **Departments → List Departments** and **Agents → List Agents** to copy a real `departmentId` / `agentId` (seeded by `npm run seed`).
2. Run **Contacts → Create Contact** and save the returned `Contact_Id` into the `contactId` collection variable.
3. Run **Tickets → Create Ticket** using those ids; save the returned `Ticket_Id` into the `ticketId` variable.
4. Exercise Conversations/Comments/History/Queues using that `ticketId`.
5. For Gmail, follow `docs/development/gmail-console-setup.md` before calling the Gmail folder's requests.

item.name: Tickets
item.description: Core ticket workflow: All Cases, Agent/Team queues, ticket detail, properties, history, resolution, metrics. Backed by HD_TICKET_MASTER + child tables.

query.description: One of: Open, On Hold, Closed
One of: P1, P2, P3, P4
One of: Created_Time, Modified_Time, Due_Date, Priority, Status, Subject

request.description:
All Cases: paginated, filterable, searchable, sortable ticket list.

**Response 200**
```json
{ "data": [ { "Ticket_Id": "...", "Ticket_Number": "000001", "Subject": "...", ... } ], "paging": { "limit": 25, "page": 1, "total": 1, "hasMore": false, "nextCursor": null } }
```

body.raw:
{
  "subject": "Cannot access dashboard",
  "description": "Getting a 500 error when I open the dashboard",
  "channel": "Web Form",
  "departmentId": "{{departmentId}}",
  "contactId": "{{contactId}}",
  "accountId": null,
  "teamId": null,
  "assigneeId": null,
  "priority": "P3",
  "statusType": "Open"
}

request.description:
Creates a ticket, its CREATED history row, and an empty metrics row in one transaction.

**Required:** `subject`, `channel` (Email | Web Form | Social | Chat | Phone), `departmentId`, `contactId`.
**Optional:** `description`, `teamId`, `accountId`, `assigneeId`, `status`, `statusType` (Open | On Hold | Closed, default Open), `priority` (P1-P4).

**Response 201** → `{ "data": { "Ticket_Id": "...", "Ticket_Number": "000001", "Status": "Open", ... } }`

**Errors:** `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), `DEPARTMENT_NOT_FOUND` (400), `CONTACT_NOT_FOUND` (400).

Full ticket record (HD_TICKET_MASTER row).

**Errors:** `TICKET_NOT_FOUND` (404).

Partial update. Any of: `subject`, `description`, `status`, `statusType`, `priority`, `departmentId`, `teamId`, `assigneeId`, `category`, `subCategory`, `classification` (at least one required).

Writes one HD_TICKET_HISTORY row per changed field (STATUS_CHANGE / PRIORITY_CHANGE / REASSIGNED / FIELD_CHANGE), all in one transaction.

**Errors:** `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400 - empty body), `TICKET_NOT_FOUND` (404).
Field-change audit trail (HD_TICKET_HISTORY), oldest first. Every ticket mutation writes here: CREATED, STATUS_CHANGE, PRIORITY_CHANGE, REASSIGNED, CONVERSATION_ADDED, COMMENT_ADDED, FIELD_CHANGE.
Most recent HD_TICKET_RESOLUTION row, or `"data": null` if the ticket has no resolution note yet.
SLA/handling metrics (HD_TICKET_METRICS): First_Response_Time_Mins, Resolution_Time_Mins, Reopen_Count, Reassign_Count, Response_Count, Handled_By_Agent_Ids.
Unified message feed for the ticket (HD_TICKET_CONVERSATION), oldest first - inbound customer email and outbound agent replies together, ordered by Sent_Time.

request.description:
Agent reply, customer-visible by default (`isPublic: false` for an internal-only conversation entry). Increments HD_TICKET_MASTER.Thread_Count and writes a CONVERSATION_ADDED history row, in one transaction.

**Required:** `content`. **Optional:** `channel` (default "Email"), `isPublic` (default true), `toAddress`, `ccAddress`.

**Errors:** `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), `TICKET_NOT_FOUND` (404).
Internal-only notes on the ticket (HD_TICKET_COMMENT), never visible to the customer, ordered by Commented_Time.

Adds an internal note. Increments HD_TICKET_MASTER.Comment_Count and writes a COMMENT_ADDED history row.

**Required:** `content`.

**Errors:** `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), `TICKET_NOT_FOUND` (404).
Tickets currently assigned to one agent (Assignee_Id = agentId). Accepts the same filter/sort query params as List Tickets.

item.name: Gmail Integration
item.description: OAuth setup + ingestion engine for the mailbox configured as GMAIL_MAILBOX in server/.env. Full walkthrough: docs/development/gmail-console-setup.md.

request.description:
Step 1 of the one-time Gmail OAuth setup. Returns a Google consent URL built from GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI. Open the returned `url` in a browser and sign in as the GMAIL_MAILBOX address.

**Response 200** → `{ "data": { "url": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?..." } }`

**Errors:** `GMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED` (500) if GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI are missing from `.env`.

query.description: Authorization code Google appends when it redirects here - you normally reach this via the browser, not by calling it manually from Postman

request.description:
Step 2 - Google redirects your browser here automatically after consent (GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI must exactly match what's registered in Google Cloud Console). Exchanges `code` for tokens and returns the refresh token **once**.

**Response 200**
```json
{ "data": { "message": "Save refresh_token to GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN in server/.env, then restart the server.", "refresh_token": "1//...", "access_token_expiry": 1234567890, "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly" } }
```
Copy `refresh_token` into `server/.env` as `GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN`, then restart the server. This is a one-time step.

Manually triggers one ingestion pass (fetch → normalize → idempotency check → contact match/create → ticket match/create → conversation + thread) for GMAIL_MAILBOX. No scheduler is wired up yet - this is a manual trigger until a cron job exists.

Optional body: `{ "mailbox": "other@sunoida.com" }` to override GMAIL_MAILBOX for one call.

**Response 200**
```json
{ "data": { "fetched": 3, "ingested": 3, "skipped": 0, "ticketsCreated": 2, "errors": [] } }
```

**Errors:** `GMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED` (500) if GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN isn't set yet (complete steps 1-2 first); `MAIL_REPLY_ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND` (500) if `npm run seed` hasn't been run for the current GMAIL_MAILBOX.
